key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: List of search providers enabled for the web search in GNOME Shell. One or more providers can be enabled at the same time; each enabled provider will show a result entry in the search overview. Valid ids are the keys in src/gnome_web_search_provider/providers.py (e.g. google, bing, duckduckgo, brave, startpage, google-images, google-maps, bing-images, youtube, ...). Unknown ids are ignored.
